Hi Samantha 
---

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Key needs we heard: predictable inference latency for customer-facing features, stricter data isolation for PII, and predictable unit economics for high-volume embedding workloads.
- Primary success criteria you mentioned: <40ms p95 for short-chat use cases, SOC 2 evidence for security review, and predictable monthly spend for forecasting.

Next steps I recommend to unblock procurement and internal alignment: 
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) 
--- 30 min: get your VP of Platform and our CTO/Head of Product on a short call to validate strategy and timelines.
2) Technical deep dive 
--- 60 min: solutions + infra deep dive with your engineering/ML leads and our solutions engineers to validate architecture and integration plan.

Attachments: I've included a draft mutual action plan and a short MOP that outlines milestones and deliverables (redwood-mop-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Exec alignment: Tue May 25 
--- 10:00
---10:30 or 15:00
---15:30 PT
- Tech deep dive: Fri May 28 
--- 11:00
---12:00 or 13:00
---14:00 PT

Would either of those work for your side? If helpful I can loop in Rishi (sales lead) and Mateo (solutions) to coordinate dates/attendees.

Thanks 
---
Marissa
